passages.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem: Hear, O peoples, all of you; listen, O earth, and everyone in it! May the Lord GOD bear witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Micah.
Micah came from Moresheth.
God spoke to Micah during the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.
Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.
God showed Micah a vision.
Micah saw things about Samaria and Jerusalem.
All peoples, listen.
Everyone on earth, pay attention.
The Lord GOD will be a witness against you.
The Lord speaks from His holy temple.
passages.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ מִיכָה֙ הַמֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ חָזָ֥ה עַל־ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ שִׁמְעוּ֙ עַמִּ֣ים כֻּלָּ֔ם הַקְשִׁ֖יבִי אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֑הּ וִיהִי֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֤ה בָּכֶם֙ לְעֵ֔ד אֲדֹנָ֖י מֵהֵיכַ֥ל קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD lives in His holy dwelling place.
The LORD is coming out from His place.
The LORD will come down to the earth.
The LORD will walk on the high places of the earth.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְיָרַ֥ד וְדָרַ֖ךְ עַל־ בָּמוֹתֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and holy.
He comes down from His dwelling place.
The mountains melt beneath Him.
The valleys split apart under Him.
The mountains melt like wax melts before fire.
The valleys split like water rushes down a slope.
passages.original: וְנָמַ֤סּוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְהָעֲמָקִ֖ים יִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ כַּדּוֹנַג֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ כְּמַ֖יִם מֻגָּרִ֥ים בְּמוֹרָֽד׃

passages.text: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is the high place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
passages.sermon:
God is acting because of the sins of Jacob.
God is acting because of the sins of the house of Israel.
Jacob has transgressed.
Samaria is the transgression of Jacob.
Judah has high places of sin.
Jerusalem is the high place of Judah.
passages.original: בְּפֶ֤שַׁע יַֽעֲקֹב֙ כָּל־ זֹ֔את וּבְחַטֹּ֖אות בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִֽי־ פֶ֣שַׁע יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲלוֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וּמִי֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲל֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field, a planting area for a vineyard. I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Samaria.
God will destroy Samaria.
God will make Samaria a heap of rubble.
This heap will be in the open field.
People will plant vineyards there.
God will pour Samaria’s stones into the valley.
God will uncover Samaria’s foundations.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י שֹׁמְר֛וֹן לְעִ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְמַטָּ֣עֵי כָ֑רֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּ֤י לַגַּי֙ אֲבָנֶ֔יהָ וִיסֹדֶ֖יהָ אֲגַלֶּֽה׃

passages.text: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces; all her wages will be burned in the fire, and I will destroy all her idols. Since she collected the wages of a prostitute, they will be used again on a prostitute.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Samaria.
Samaria has many carved images.
God will smash all her carved images to pieces.
Samaria has received wages from sinful acts.
God will burn all her wages in the fire.
Samaria has many idols.
God will destroy all her idols.
Samaria collected her wealth like a prostitute collects wages.
Her wealth will return to be used for prostitution again.
passages.original: וְכָל־ פְּסִילֶ֣יהָ יֻכַּ֗תּוּ וְכָל־ אֶתְנַנֶּ֙יהָ֙ יִשָּׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וְכָל־ עֲצַבֶּ֖יהָ אָשִׂ֣ים שְׁמָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י מֵאֶתְנַ֤ן זוֹנָה֙ קִבָּ֔צָה וְעַד־ אֶתְנַ֥ן זוֹנָ֖ה יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃

passages.text: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will walk barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Micah speaks these words.
Micah sees the coming destruction of Samaria.
Micah feels deep sorrow because of this.
He says, “Because of this, I will lament.”
He says, “I will wail.”
He says, “I will walk barefoot.”
He says, “I will walk naked.”
He says, “I will howl like a jackal.”
He says, “I will mourn like an ostrich.”
passages.original: עַל־ זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְאֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה שֵׁילָל וְעָר֑וֹם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה מִסְפֵּד֙ כַּתַּנִּ֔ים וְאֵ֖בֶל כִּבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: For her wound is incurable; it has reached even Judah; it has approached the gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem itself.
passages.sermon:
Micah is a prophet of God.
Micah speaks about the sin and judgment of Samaria and Israel.
Her wound cannot be healed.
The wound is very serious.
The wound has spread to Judah.
The wound has reached the gate of my people.
The wound has come as far as Jerusalem.
passages.original: כִּ֥י אֲנוּשָׁ֖ה מַכּוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּי־ בָ֙אָה֙ עַד־ יְהוּדָ֔ה נָגַ֛ע עַד־ שַׁ֥עַר עַמִּ֖י עַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah.
passages.sermon:
Micah is a prophet of God.
Micah speaks to the people of Israel and Judah.
Micah warns them about coming judgment.
Micah says, "Do not tell this news in Gath."
Gath is a city of the Philistines.
Do not weep in Gath.
Do not show your sorrow there.
In Beth-leaphrah, roll in the dust.
Show your grief in Beth-leaphrah.
Express your mourning there.
passages.original: בְּגַת֙ אַל־ תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל־ תִּבְכּ֑וּ בְּבֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה עָפָ֖ר הִתְפַּלָּשְׁתִּי׃

passages.text: Depart in shameful nakedness, O dwellers of Shaphir. The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out. Beth-ezel is in mourning; its support is taken from you.
passages.sermon:
The people of Shaphir must leave.
They leave in shame and nakedness.
The people of Zaanan do not come out.
Beth-ezel mourns.
Beth-ezel has lost its support from you.
passages.original: עִבְרִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁפִ֖יר עֶרְיָה־ בֹ֑שֶׁת לֹ֤א יָֽצְאָה֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צַֽאֲנָ֔ן מִסְפַּד֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵ֔צֶל יִקַּ֥ח מִכֶּ֖ם עֶמְדָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The people of Maroth wanted good things.
They waited and hoped for good.
But the LORD sent disaster instead.
This disaster reached even the gate of Jerusalem.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חָ֥לָֽה לְט֖וֹב יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת מָר֑וֹת כִּֽי־ יָ֤רַד רָע֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Harness your chariot horses, O dweller of Lachish. You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
passages.sermon:
The people of Lachish lived in a city in Judah.
God spoke to the people of Lachish.
God told them to harness their chariot horses.
God said, “You, people of Lachish, began the sin of Zion.”
God said, “The sins of Israel were found in you.”
passages.original: רְתֹ֧ם הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לָרֶ֖כֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ רֵאשִׁ֨ית חַטָּ֥את הִיא֙ לְבַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן כִּי־ בָ֥ךְ נִמְצְא֖וּ פִּשְׁעֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Therefore, send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
He tells them to send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath.
The houses of Achzib will deceive the kings of Israel.
The kings will trust Achzib, but Achzib will not help them.
passages.original: לָכֵן֙ תִּתְּנִ֣י שִׁלּוּחִ֔ים עַ֖ל מוֹרֶ֣שֶׁת גַּ֑ת בָּתֵּ֤י אַכְזִיב֙ לְאַכְזָ֔ב לְמַלְכֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I will again bring a conqueror against you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Mareshah.
God says, “I will send a conqueror against you.”
You live in Mareshah.
A conqueror will come to you.
The glory of Israel will go to Adullam.
passages.original: עֹ֗ד הַיֹּרֵשׁ֙ אָ֣בִי לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה עַד־ עֲדֻּלָּ֥ם יָב֖וֹא כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children; make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
Your children are precious to you.
You will lose your children.
They will go away from you into exile.
Mourn for your children.
Shave your heads.
Cut off your hair.
Make yourselves bald like an eagle.
You do this to show your deep sorrow.
passages.original: קָרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־ בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י גָל֖וּ מִמֵּֽךְ׃ס
